versions.content: If function EthTrcv_SetTransceiverWakeupMode() is called with ETHTRCV_WUM_CLEAR and the internal cable diagnostic state is different from ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall clear stored wakeup events on the indexed transceiver.

{OBSOLETE} If function EthTrcv_SetTransceiverWakeupMode() is called with ETHTRCV_WUM_CLEAR and the internal cable diagnostic state is different from ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall clear stored wakeup events on the indexed transceiver.
